assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent damage crack overlay for an arcade game.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact crack-layout template. Image 2 is ONLY a material/style reference (the colorful beveled enamel game enemies).
PRIMARY REQUEST: reproduce image 1's crack network almost exactly, changing ONLY its rendering from pixelated gray lines to crisp illustrated recessed fractures with charcoal dark gaps and very slim warm ivory stone/enamel chipped highlights.
LAYOUT LOCK: preserve the exact normalized positions, angles, turns, branch junctions, endpoints, lengths, overall width and occupied bounding box of ALL cracks from image 1. Do not recenter, enlarge, rotate or rearrange the crack network within the square canvas. The transparent empty space is intentional and MUST remain in the same places. Do not invent new branches. Smooth the pixel stair-steps into angular hand-painted lines without changing their paths. No square border, no rim, no new outer decoration.
All areas between the cracks must be genuinely transparent, not filled with stone, color or haze. Thin beveled edge highlights should be subtle, dark fracture gaps should remain dominant. One square sprite, ideally 1024x1024, same full-square registration as image 1, true transparent alpha. No text, no background, no checkerboard, no enemy icon or colored block from image 2.
This is LIGHT damage. Preserve the small three-pronged fork offset to the right and slightly below center, including its short bent upper-left arm, rightward arm and downward arm. It occupies only approximately x35–74% and y27–76% of the canvas. Keep all that empty space on the left and above; DO NOT center it or add cracks.
